claimed_purpose.text: Persistent companion memory system storing message logs, curated memory fragments, consolidated episode memories, entity profiles, and a user model across sessions in a SQLite database.
Memory Constellations has a distinct memory pipeline separate from chat, involving multiple named modules for extraction, classification, and user modeling.
A growing AI memory system that extracts fragments from chat, aggregates them into narrative episodes, and weaves them into long-term memory arcs.
Self-organizing memory system for AI companions that extracts facts, groups them by topic, and merges them into coherent narratives automatically.

mechanisms.text: readUserRawMessages reads up to 150 raw user messages and calls LLM to produce a current_state impression. LLM returns action='extend' (update TTL of existing entry) or 'create' (resolve all prior deep_cycle snapshots and write new entry). Includes a retrospective audit: LLM evaluates whether the previous state prediction was confirmed, wrong, or unverifiable, and the verdict is written to evolution_history.

Profile integration (integrateProfileTraits) applies a stability tier gate before writing traits into the user profile. 'locked' category (basic) is never created or refined by the model. 'high' tier (personality, communication) requires source_diversity ≥ 5 and can only refine existing entries. 'medium' tier requires source_diversity ≥ 3. 'low' tier requires diversity ≥ 1.

Isolation: the model is per-user (single user assumed; no multi-user keying in user_model table). Entries are tagged by created_by ('chat_companion' or 'deep_cycle') to distinguish real-time companion writes from scheduled deep-cycle writes, and different resolution rules apply to each source.

Retrieved fragments are grouped by entity (person, place, work) before context injection to prevent cross-entity contamination in generation. A cross-person warning is appended when ≥2 person entities appear in the same injection.

Scribe extracts facts from new chat messages as short third-person sentences, stores them in memory_fragments table, and indexes them to ChromaDB (vector) and FTS5 (keyword). Triggered by silence ≥20 min or backlog ≥100 messages.

Persisted store is a SQLite table called memory_fragments. Each fragment has type, entity, content, emotional_weight, source, source_date, source_msg_ids, is_rp, chat_mode, value_tags, priority, and content_hash columns.

A correction_log captures manual deletions of both memories and fragments as correction signals, with active entries accumulating until a merge threshold (10) triggers distillation into long-term guidelines

Retrieval into the prompt is performed by a separate Librarian module using hybrid search; up to 15 fragments are injected into the Scribe prompt as deduplication context before new fragments are written.
Retrieve: /api/recall endpoint accepts a query and limit, returns a formatted field — pre-assembled text of relevant memory fragments + narrative + entity profiles — ready to inject into LLM prompt.
Scribe runs table tracks incremental extraction jobs: processed_until datetime, messages_processed, and fragments_written — marking the write path from message log to fragment store.
Stale ChromaDB entries (fragments whose status is no longer 'active' but whose chroma_id is not null) are cleaned up by deleting them from ChromaDB and nulling chroma_id in SQLite.
Cross-day identical content is explicitly not deduplicated, because same content on different dates is treated as source_diversity evidence for stable traits.
Memories are persisted in a SQLite `memories` table with fields including content, tags, status, valid_from, valid_to, layer; content is stored encrypted.
Sagas are cross-entity narrative arcs stored in memory_sagas, experimental and not yet consumed in production, updated every 24h or on new episodes.
Write path — long-term arc: Saga (memory arc) runs every 24 hours automatically, or immediately after consolidate produces a new episode.
Memory fragments carry a status field ('active' default) enabling soft-delete or lifecycle transitions without physical row deletion.
Fragment types distinguish curated memory categories: fact, state, observation, preference, event, intention, reflection, entity_new.
Memory sagas group related memories under a titled narrative arc with status and an emotional_axis field that drives retrieval bias.
Messages are stored encrypted; the scribe decrypts them at extraction time using an encryption module before formatting for the LLM.
Deep Cycle (Archivist) is idle-gated: only triggers after 1 hour of inactivity to avoid competing with the chat LLM for resources.
Deep cycle performs classify, rematch, and graduate operations, suggesting memory items are classified and promoted through tiers.
On update, embedding is only regenerated when title or content has actually changed; unchanged content skips vector update
Vector/semantic retrieval is provided via ChromaDB; without it, retrieval degrades to keyword search.
All embedding runs locally with no API cost, meaning vector representations are generated on-device.

ledger.claim: Librarian is the retrieve path: hybrid RRF fusion of FTS5 + vector + entity aggregation, with episodes weighted 1.5× over raw fragments, and a score floor of 0.005 below which results are dropped.
ledger.quote:
Librarian ── called at chat-time
    │       ── Hybrid search: FTS5 + vector + entity aggregation
    │       ── RRF fusion, episodes weighted 1.5× over raw fragments
    │       ── Results tagged with recall permission level
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory is isolated per user/companion pair via memory_config.json naming; no multi-user isolation mechanism described beyond single-instance configuration.
ledger.quote: "user": { "name": "Your name" ... }, "ai": { "name": "Companion name" ... }
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Forget/decay is implemented as a lifecycle: fragments progress from active → cooling (14 days no access, vector deleted at 30 days) → tombstone (content wiped at 90 days). Access resets the timer.
ledger.quote:
Fragments | 14 days no access | 30 days, vector deleted | 90 days, content wiped
Access resets the timer — memories that get recalled stay fresh. Cooling fragments that are accessed auto-revive to active.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Recall permission level acts as a generation scaffold: associate-only memories must not be stated as fact to the user, enforcing a retrieve-without-speak policy for old or low-confidence hits.
ledger.quote: 仅联想 (associate-only) | >90 days or floated at random | Internal reference only — don't state as fact to the user
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Correction path cools the source memory and writes a corrected fragment; hallucinations are logged separately. Accumulated corrections become editing guidelines re-injected into Scribe to prevent re-extraction of known errors.
ledger.quote:
if it did, that memory is cooled down and a corrected fragment is written; if it didn't, the mistake is logged as a hallucination and the correct version is stored as a new memory.
Once 10 are active they get merged into long-term "editing guidelines", and both the recent corrections and those guidelines are injected into Scribe's prompt — so the same mistake doesn't get re-extracted later. See services/correction.js.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The Scribe prompt instructs the LLM to ban frequency-generalizing words (always/never/often) for single observed events, preventing fabricated behavioral patterns.
ledger.quote: ─ 禁止「每次/总是/经常/从不」等频率泛化词——单次行为就是单次。昨天{{user.pronoun}}说冷 ≠ {{user.pronoun}}每次都说冷。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: processed_until timestamp validation guards against corrupt values that would cause Scribe to permanently skip all messages; fallback is full re-scan from 2000-01-01.
ledger.quote:
// 防护：processed_until 必须为有效日期，否则兜底到 2000-01-01（全量重扫）
    // 历史上出现过 JSON 对象被误写入此字段导致 Scribe 永久跳过（NaN 时间计算）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory Constellations is a growing AI memory system, not keyword search, with a pipeline: fragment extraction (Scribe) → episode aggregation → Saga arcs → jiwen emotional baseline.
ledger.quote: 记忆星图（Memory Constellations）是一个 会生长的 AI 记忆系统 。它不是关键词检索，而是：从聊天中自动提取碎片（Scribe）把碎片聚合成叙事段落（episode）把叙事编织成长期记忆弧线（Saga）通过持续内在状态引擎（jiwen）让记忆影响 AI 的情绪基线
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Scribe extraction is triggered by silence ≥ 20 min + backlog ≥ 60 messages, or backlog ≥ 100 messages.
ledger.quote: Scribe 触发条件是：沉默 ≥ 20min + 积压 ≥ 60 条消息，或积压 ≥ 100 条
ledger.locator: Section 4 — 常见问题 / Q: 没有碎片被提取
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Deep Cycle (Archivist) is idle-gated to 1 hour of inactivity before triggering, to avoid competing with the chat LLM.
ledger.quote: Deep Cycle 只在空闲 1 小时后触发（正常行为——不在聊天时抢 LLM 资源）
ledger.locator: Section 4 — 常见问题 / Q: 星座不增长
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Episode (narrative segment) consolidation requires a constellation to accumulate 15+ fragments before the consolidate task runs.
ledger.quote: 需要星座积累 15+ 条碎片后，Deep Cycle 的 consolidate 任务会自动运行。
ledger.locator: Section 3.3 — 星座 → 叙事片段（episode）
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Saga (memory arc) runs every 24 hours or immediately after consolidate produces a new episode.
ledger.quote: 每 24 小时自动运行一次（或在 consolidate 产出新 episode 后立即触发）。
ledger.locator: Section 3.4 — 叙事片段 → Saga（记忆弧线）
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Fragments with status consolidated/inactive must be deleted from ChromaDB to prevent stale results from polluting retrieval.
ledger.quote: 确认 memory_fragments 中 status 为 consolidated / inactive 的碎片已从 ChromaDB 中删除（否则会污染搜索结果）
ledger.locator: Section 4 — 常见问题 / Q: 记忆搜索总是返回很早之前的结果
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The /api/recall endpoint returns a pre-formatted text field combining relevant fragments, narrative, and entity profiles for direct LLM prompt injection.
ledger.quote: 返回 formatted 字段就是拼好的、可直接塞进 prompt 的文本（相关记忆碎片 + 叙事 + 实体档案）。
ledger.locator: Section 7.3 — 查询记忆（用记忆让回复更懂你）
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Each memory fragment stores source_msg_ids enabling traceback to original messages via recall_memory tool.
ledger.quote: 每条记忆碎片存储 source_msg_ids （原始消息 ID 列表），你的伴侣可以通过 recall_memory 工具追溯到消息来源。
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: core-prompt.txt is the scaffold layer: it holds AI persona and behavioral rules; variables are substituted from memory_config.json. The page explicitly states this file must be written by the user because it is the AI's soul.
ledger.quote: 这是最重要的文件——你的 AI 的全部人格和行为规则。……core-prompt.txt 的人格提示词必须用户自己写。你可以给结构和示例，但不能代笔——那是他们 AI 的灵魂。
ledger.locator: Section 2.5 — 写人格提示词; Section 5 — 给 Claude Code Agent 的辅助配置脚本
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Memory Constellations is a self-organizing memory system for AI companions that extracts, organizes, and retrieves facts automatically without manual curation.
ledger.quote: A self-organizing memory system for AI companions. Extracts facts from chat, groups them by topic, and merges them into coherent narratives — all on autopilot.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Episode contradiction detection occurs during deep cycle consolidation.
ledger.quote: Episodes: memories (layer=episode), Merged fragment narratives, 100-250 chars, with date correction and contradiction detection
ledger.locator: README.md, Memory layers / Core memory layers table
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Scribe is the write path: triggered by silence or message backlog, extracts typed facts into memory_fragments, indexes to both vector and keyword stores.
ledger.quote: Scribe ── triggered by silence ≥20min or backlog ≥100 messages │ ── extracts facts → memory_fragments table │ ── indexes to ChromaDB (vector) + FTS5 (keyword)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Forget/deprecation is implemented as a tiered lifecycle: vector deletion at 30 days no access, content wipe at 90 days. Access resets the timer.
ledger.quote: Fragments: Active → Cooling: 14 days no access, Cooling → Frozen: 30 days, vector deleted, Frozen → Tombstone: 90 days, content wiped … Access resets the timer — memories that get recalled stay fresh.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Recall permission tagging suppresses stale or low-confidence memories at generation time without deleting them: associate-only memories are not stated as fact to the user.
ledger.quote: 仅联想 (associate-only): >90 days or floated at random, Internal reference only — don't state as fact to the user.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Conflict/correction handling: matched wrong memories are cooled (not deleted), a corrected fragment is written, and correction patterns are fed back into Scribe's extraction prompt.
ledger.quote: if it did, that memory is cooled down and a corrected fragment is written; if it didn't, the mistake is logged as a hallucination and the correct version is stored as a new memory … both the recent corrections and those guidelines are injected into Scribe's prompt — so the same mistake doesn't get re-extracted later.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Transient user states (current_state) auto-expire by TTL; the companion can also explicitly resolve a state mid-chat.
ledger.quote: current_state (瞬态): Hours to days, TTL-expiring … resolve: Mark something as ended … States auto-expire.
ledger.locator: README.md, Memory layers / User model layers; Companion tools / manage_user_state
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Behavior pattern confidence is monotonically increasing by design — absence of recent mention does not reduce confidence.
ledger.quote: Behavior pattern confidence only increases — a person doesn't 'stop preferring something they have always liked' just because they haven't mentioned it in three months.
ledger.locator: README.md, Memory layers / User model layers
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Results below combined score floor 0.005 are silently dropped at retrieval time — the system prefers silence over noisy recall.
ledger.quote: Results below a combined score floor (0.005) are silently dropped — better silence than noise.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Isolation is single user / single companion per deployment; multi-user or multi-agent isolation is not described.
ledger.quote: "user": {"name": "Your name", ...}, "ai": {"name": "Companion name", ...}
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Memory pipeline cost is estimated at approximately $0.22/day (~$7/month) for an active user at June 2026 flash-lite pricing, excluding chat model costs.
ledger.quote: Total: ~$0.22/day, ~$7/month at June 2026 flash-lite pricing. Actual cost depends on chat volume and model choice.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Memory Constellations runs as a standalone Docker container service listening on port 3000, separate from the chat bot.
ledger.quote: 记忆库跑成一个 Docker 容器 （独立服务，监听 3000 端口）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: A component named Scribe is responsible for extracting memory fragments from messages on the write path.
ledger.quote: AstrBot 收到的用户消息 → 自动 POST 给记忆库 → Scribe 提取记忆碎片
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Semantic retrieval requires ChromaDB; without it the system falls back to keyword retrieval, meaning vector search is optional not core.
ledger.quote: 没有 ChromaDB 时记忆库仍能跑、能提取碎片，只是「向量语义检索」降级为「关键词检索」。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The store is encrypted; deployment requires a random SANCTUARY_ENCRYPTION_KEY to be generated.
ledger.quote: openssl rand -hex 32 # 填到 SANCTUARY_ENCRYPTION_KEY
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory pipeline is architecturally separate from chat, with its own model calls and cost budget.
ledger.quote: Memory pipeline only (excluding chat)
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Deep cycle implements a multi-stage memory lifecycle with classify, rematch, and graduate steps, running ~15 times per day.
ledger.quote: Deep cycle (classify/rematch/graduate)	~15	flash-lite	~$0.03
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Embeddings are generated locally using Jina and fastembed, incurring no API cost.
ledger.quote: All embedding runs locally (Jina + fastembed), zero API cost
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Chat responses use better models and carry full context windows, and are the main cost driver, separate from memory pipeline costs.
ledger.quote: Chat responses use better models (Flash or Pro) and carry full context windows. Budget ~$0.50-1.00/day for active conversation, depending on model choice and message volume.
ledger.label: inferred

unknowns.text: Scaffold / instruction layer (what prompt instructions tell the model to do with retrieved memories) is not present in this retrieval module.
The jiwen (持续内在状态引擎) mechanism is named but not described: how it reads from the memory store, what state it persists, and how it modifies the emotional baseline are not explained in this page.
correct_memory implementation details are referenced to services/correction.js but that file is not included on this page.
